items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: And I went to Son Thomas a little while.

ctx.x: Yeah, on the steps. How old were you then?
Well, I was around about 10 or 12 years old during that time. Then I picked up on a banjo. And I went to Son Thomas a little while. And then we started off in school. The Spasm Band.
